title_zh: 约定继续封闭风暴后的游乐场

scenario.label_zh: 约定继续封闭风暴后的游乐场
scenario.goal_zh: 说明风暴碎片尚未清除，并确定等待维护人员检查后再考虑重新开放

context_zh: 虚构社区公园场景：风暴后游乐场已有围栏，志愿者向管理员核对开放状态。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: The storm was damaging, but the play equipment looks all right from here. Can we open the gate?

sentences.speaker: Park manager
sentences.text: Not yet. There is debris around the slide, and we have not had an inspection.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: I can see a broken branch beyond the barrier. I will keep visitors outside.

sentences.speaker: Park manager
sentences.text: Thank you. The maintenance team is due this afternoon; they will clear the area and assess the equipment.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: So the gate stays closed until you tell us the inspection and cleanup are complete?

sentences.speaker: Park manager
sentences.text: Exactly. I'll update you when we have that confirmation.
